text: Based on the provided data, there is insufficient evidence to confirm any fire on the asset during the evaluated period from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-25. While no thermal anomalies were detected by the sensors (MODIS, VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21) for the covered days, there was a temporal gap in the data from 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25. Therefore, we cannot definitively say that there was no fire, as small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected, and the last day of the period was not covered by the sensors.
